column2: DESCRIPTION
Experimental year
column4: Trial began in 2008 and continued through  2010 for estimating the cover crop data.  The last year to collect response crop data was 2011.

column2: Replication
Plot number
Cover Crop treatment by number

Treatments consisted of seven different cover crop monocultures; each in a different functional group and a series of cover crop mixtures, which included the same seven cover crops but had selected functional groups removed from the mixture
column4: 1 = No cover crop (check/control) [C]; 2 = Purple top turnip [PTT]; 3 = Proso millet [PM]; 4 = Spring triticale [ST]; 5 = Soybean [S]; 6 = Vine pea [VP]; 7 = Winter canola [WC]; 8 = Sunflower [SF]; 9 = Upper benchmark (2-8 mixed) [HD]; 10 = drop- purple top turnip [DPTT]; 11 = drop- proso millet [DPM]; 12 = drop- spring triticale [DST]; 13 = drop- soybean [DS]; 14 = drop- vine pea [DVP]; 15 = drop- winter canola [DWC]; 16 = drop- sunflower [DSF]; 17 = drop- proso millet and spring triticale [DPMST]; 18 = drop- soybean and vine pea [DSVP]; 19 = drop- winter canola and sunflower [DWCSF]; 20 = No cover crop (drill is run across plot for residue incorporation, no seed) [CD]
